reference_wording_corrections: All eight dance references now separate reviewed single-frame evidence from unobserved return/cycle/travel, and questions specify camera/direction cues. Sport pickup and surgery woven references are corrected to actual frames.
expected_stage_ids_policy: All32 stage cases remain singleton original primary IDs. No alternate stage IDs added. Ten uncertainty cases use empty arrays.
protocol_limitations: Six frames over five seconds is longer than the original three frames over one second. Any gains combine sampling/question-anchor changes; do not call this an isolated algorithm improvement.
A five-second interval can cross an edited shot boundary. The runner must preserve actual frame timestamps and disclose mixed phases.
Single reviewed stills do not prove action completion; retained guide criteria need temporal or other evidence.
Lexical concept matching is a screening proxy and is not semantic, clinical, equipment, or safety validation.
